title: God-consciousness is received, not staged
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 273
summary: This section opens by saying the God-conscious being knows God and loves the One alone. It keeps insisting that such stature is given by God Himself, which means greatness, purity, and fearlessness cannot be self-manufactured.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person who feels unseen and tries to build spiritual worth through effort or image. Taken seriously, it returns identity to what God causes rather than what the self stages.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: let God, not image, decide what greatness is.

lines.translation: The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.
Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee jis karai prabh aap ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.
The God-conscious being is gloriously great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kaa dharas baddabhaagee paieeaai ||
lines.translation: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by great good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kau bal bal jaieeaai ||
lines.translation: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.
The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.
O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||

structure: First, it starts with intimate knowledge and singular love for God.
Then, it treats purity and carefree living as fruit, not performance.
Finally, it ends by saying the God-conscious being is made by God, then lifted into true greatness.
